description: Tracks SerpAPI call usage to avoid hitting the 100/month free tier limit. Updated by scheduled tasks each time a SerpAPI call is made. Reset at start of each calendar month.

budget_rules.note: With 100 calls/month, budget ~3/day max. Most searches should use Chrome browser automation instead.
reserve_calls_for: Searching Google for 'xtrata.xyz' mentions outside of Twitter
Searching Google for Stacks ecosystem news (not on Twitter)
Finding content that browser automation cannot easily reach
never_use_serpapi_for: Twitter/X thread searches (use Chrome + x.com search instead)
Checking xtrata.xyz live mints (use Chrome + WebFetch)
